statusDetail: Maintenance now has after-service shortcuts that prefill Quick Maintenance Update for oil, wheel, battery, and filter work.
actionRequired: No action needed. Use Maintenance Closeout after a job to save mileage and notes into the existing Garage log.
summary: Added a near-top Maintenance Service Closeout panel with four after-job shortcuts. Each shortcut reuses the existing Quick Maintenance Update form by selecting the matching service type, prefilling an editable completion note, scrolling to the form, and focusing mileage so the saved entry still goes through the current Garage maintenance log path. Updated search metadata, the offline cache version, and browser smoke coverage.
impactReason: After a job, iPhone users can tap the finished service and save mileage plus notes without manually building the Garage log entry.
